detaileddescription.para: Utilities for converting between M2 types and standard C++ types

briefdescription.para: Conversion helpers between M2 boundary types and standard C++ containers.

detaileddescription.para: Provides the bidirectional converters every engine boundary needs, all inline so call sites stay free. Strings: string_std_to_M2 / string_M2_to_std marshal between std::string and M2_string (the engine's length-prefixed type). String arrays: M2_ArrayString_to_stdvector (in two overloads one filling a caller-supplied std::vector<std::string>&, one returning a fresh vector) and stdvector_to_M2_ArrayString. Integer arrays: stdvector_to_M2_arrayint is templated on the element type T (with overloads for both std::vector<T> and gc_vector<T>), static_cast-ing each entry to int; the inverse M2_arrayint_to_stdvector<T> produces a fresh std::vector<T>. A trailing templated operator<<(std::ostream&, const std::vector<T>&) overload provides a [a b c ]-style debug dump for any printable element type.
